why.label: Why Hollywood Hotel
why.description: Hollywood Hotel is more than just a place to stay. It is a world unto itself — with over 100 rooms and suites, three event halls seating up to 350 guests, a rooftop lounge bar, a full-service spa, and an Olympic-sized swimming pool. Whatever brings you here, we make it unforgettable.
features: Over 100 luxury rooms and suites across 5 tiers
Three event halls for any occasion — from boardroom to grand gala
Rooftop Lounge & Bar with panoramic city views
Shuttle service and prime city-centre location

rooms.title: Rooms & Suites
rooms.subtitle: Five tiers of luxury accommodation — from comfortable standard rooms to our exclusive Presidential Suite.
rooms.standardDesc: Perfect for the solo traveler or a quick overnight stay. Clean, comfortable, and efficient with all the essentials.
rooms.deluxeDesc: Spacious comfort with extra amenities. Ideal for couples or business travelers needing more room to relax and unwind.
rooms.executiveDesc: Premium comfort with a dedicated workspace and premium finishes for the traveling professional who demands more.
rooms.hollywoodDesc: Our signature suite offering a separate living area, premium city views, and luxury amenities that define glamour.
rooms.presidentialDesc: The pinnacle of Hollywood Hotel luxury. An entire private floor with a grand master bedroom, personal butler, private dining room, and a terrace with panoramic views.
